prompts.image:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Generate a NEW single photorealistic live-action movie frame from the ORIGINAL references, never an edit of an earlier generated frame. 16:9 landscape, target1920x1080. The FIRST image is the authoritative Blender spatial blueprint. Its camera extrinsics, projection, crop, perspective, silhouettes, object positions and relative scales are LOCKED. Build realistic surfaces and shapes INSIDE those projected envelopes. Do not improve the composition, reframe, enlarge people, move the feather, or substitute the viewpoint of supporting photos. In particular match the single white feather's visible contour, angle, center and endpoints exactly. It is a normal 36cm feather close to camera, not an enormous object in the environment. Preserve the depth relationship foreground feather / background scene. Reference photos supply ONLY identity, clothing, vehicle design and real Poznań materials as specified below. Consistent early evening blue dusk, restrained warm lamps and lit windows, believable natural photographic detail. No plastic CGI, no fantasy architecture, no watermark, no captions, no invented prominent people. Primitives are spatial proxies, NOT literal cubic buildings/people/vehicles. Anatomically correct humans and mechanically plausible objects. OUTPUT ONLY ONE IMAGE. Spatial fidelity takes priority over beauty.
Image2 canonical GRUZAR G84 truck: deep cherry-black cab with gold ornaments, real chrome grille bars, angular chrome G hexagonal emblem, rectangular lights. Image3 real Poznań background architectural detailing only. Camera close to front of truck at grille height, front truck occupies RIGHT 60% and is heavily cropped by top and right edges exactly as image1. DO NOT show whole truck or roof. Left edge of grille approximatelyx40%, top of grille y35%, bumper y84–98%, windshield cropped uppermost area. Feather is SMALL and nearly HORIZONTAL in front of grille, bbox x47–56%,y45–53%; tip upper LEFT, quill lower RIGHT. It must remain white feather, not a logo or paint. Preserve its exact apparent size; no enlarging to showcase it. Left background is bridge parapet running perspective with distant mid-rise Poznań buildings lit windows. Grey primitive bars on front become canonical grille inside same rectangular envelope. No driver portrait inserted into grille, no duplicated truck, no extra axle or lamps. Dusk lighting with realistic headlights but no overblown bloom.
prompts.animation: 0–3s: Already airborne ahead of the grille, the single feather drifts sideways clear of the truck and settles into a low hover above the silver car's hood, reaching the End Frame without landing. Camera: continuously tracks the feather through open air, revealing the car below. The truck drives straight past the camera until its rear wheels cross the upper background toward screen right; the opposing silver car advances toward screen left. Neither vehicle reverses or turns. Airflow gently rolls the feather from tip-left to tip-right; its shaft remains intact. Use @Image1 only for the same truck's rigid construction and decorations. Preserve feather size, dusk lighting and vehicle separation. No cuts, dissolves, morphing, duplicated feathers, new people or passage through vehicles.
